items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Dixon Gayer of Downbeat had given me a great write-up.

ctx.x: How did you go to a sell-out crowd in Orchestra Hall from performing in Kankakee, performing with a couple dance bands and as a solo artist in the clubs? What was the process of going to that next tier and to a very major step?
Dixon Gayer of Downbeat had given me a great write-up.
Prior to the Orchestra Hall concert? Was it just on the basis of that one review?
